title: सूरज डूबते ही गायब हो जाती है परछाई!
topic: एक अनोखा गाँव जहाँ सूरज ढलते ही सबकी परछाइयाँ गायब होकर गाँव के पुराने कुएँ में उतरने लगती हैं, और नन्हा चिंटू अपनी परछाई को ढूँढने निकल पड़ता है।
description: सोचिए अगर सूरज ढलते ही आपकी परछाई अचानक गायब हो जाए और अंधेरे में कुछ खोजने लगे? देखिए कहानी पतंग की यह अनोखी और रहस्यमयी कहानी। #KahaniPatang #KidsStories #MagicStory #HindiKahani #BedtimeStories
thumb_visual: English: extreme close-up of a 7-year-old Indian boy face with clear shock and wide eyes, cinematic lighting, dark background with a single glowing light source

characters.चिंटू: English character sheet: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सोचिए... अगर आज शाम सूरज ढलते ही आपकी परछाई आपका साथ छोड़ दे तो क्या होगा?
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, walking in a dusty village street at sunset, long shadows cast on the ground, golden hour lighting, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अरे! चौंकिए मत... यह कोई मज़ाक नहीं है।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, standing in front of his house looking down at the ground with a puzzled expression, evening light, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आज हम बात कर रहे हैं रूपपुर गाँव की... जहाँ कल शाम कुछ ऐसा हुआ, जिसे देखकर सबकी आँखें खुली रह गईं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: A peaceful small Indian village at dusk, mud houses with thatched roofs, winding dirt paths, smoke rising from a chimney, dim orange sky, wide shot, no people.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: शाम के ठीक साढ़े पाँच बजे थे। हमारे नन्हे चिंटू ने घर के आँगन में जैसे ही कदम रखा...
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, walking into a traditional Indian courtyard with potted plants, late afternoon sun, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसने ज़मीन पर देखा... और उसकी चीख निकलते-निकलते बची!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, staring wide-eyed at the empty ground where his shadow should be, dramatic lighting, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अरे! उसकी परछाई वहाँ थी ही नहीं! सूरज की रोशनी थी, लेकिन पैर के नीचे बिल्कुल सन्नाटा!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, looking down at his feet standing on bright sunlit mud, complete absence of a shadow, top-down medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू ने घबराकर चारों तरफ देखा। गली के बाकी लोगों की परछाइयाँ भी गायब थीं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, looking around a village lane where other villagers are standing with no shadows on the ground, twilight, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अब ध्यान से सुनिए... तभी गाँव के पुराने पीपल के पेड़ के पास से एक अजीब सी सुरीली आवाज़ आई— झन... झन... झन!
scenes.style: mysterious whisper, drawing the listener in
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: An old massive Peepal tree in an Indian village square, twisting roots, hanging aerial roots, deep blue twilight sky, faint glowing sparkles near the trunk, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आप होते तो क्या करते? क्या आप उस डरावनी आवाज़ के पास जाते या घर में छिप जाते?
scenes.style: direct question to viewer, playful yet curious
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, biting his lip in confusion while looking towards a dark alley, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन हमारा चिंटू डरपोक नहीं था! उसने हिम्मत जुटाई और उस आवाज़ का पीछा करना शुरू कर दिया।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, walking with a determined expression down a narrow village lane holding a small wooden stick, evening light, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नंगे पाँव चलते-चलते चिंटू गाँव के उस पुराने सूखे कुएँ तक पहुँच गया, जिसके पास जाने से सब डरते थे।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: An ancient stone well in the middle of an overgrown courtyard, cracked masonry, dark empty opening, creeping vines, twilight sky, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और जब उसने कुएँ के अंदर झाँका... तो उसके मुँह से निकला— बाप रे!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, leaning over the edge of a deep stone well with eyes wide in shock, low-angle shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कुएँ के अंदर अंधेरा नहीं था... बल्कि वहाँ हज़ारों परछाइयाँ आपस में मिलकर एक जादुई नाच नाच रही थीं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Inside a deep magical well, glowing silhouettes and shadows dancing in circles, emitting soft blue and purple light, magical particles floating upward, fantasy style, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तभी चिंटू की परछाई ने कुएँ के अंदर से हाथ हिलाकर उसे बुलाया! सोचिए, अपनी ही परछाई को बोलते देखना कैसा लगा होगा?
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, looking down into the well as a friendly dark shadow waves back at him with glowing outlines, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू ने पूछा— तुम वहाँ क्या कर रही हो? परछाई ने हँसकर कहा— अरे चिंटू, हम दिनभर धूप में थक जाती हैं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, talking down into the well, soft moonlight reflecting on his face, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सूरज ढलते ही हम यहाँ आराम करने और थोड़ा खेलने आती हैं। लेकिन अब हमें वापस लौटना होगा!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Magical glowing shadows resting inside the stone well like fluffy clouds, soft ambient blue glow, fantasy illustration style, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू समझ गया कि परछाइयों को भी आराम की ज़रूरत होती है। उसने मुस्कुराते हुए कहा— ठीक है, पर सुबह समय पर लौट आना!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, smiling warmly and waving goodbye into the well, night sky full of stars, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगली सुबह जब सूरज उगा, तो चिंटू की परछाई फिर से उसके पैरों के पास मुस्कुराती हुई खड़ी थी।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, jumping happily in the morning sunlight with a clear shadow on the ground, bright daylight, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तो दोस्तों, कहानी अच्छी लगी हो तो सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें और अगली जादुई कहानी का इंतज़ार करें!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue denim shorts, Indian look, waving happily towards the camera in a sunny village courtyard, bright cheerful lighting, medium shot.
